# Configuration reference

*Generated by [scripts/config-reference.mjs](../../scripts/config-reference.mjs) from [config.v1.schema.json](../contracts/config.v1.schema.json) and [config.v1.environment.json](../contracts/config.v1.environment.json). Do not edit by hand: change those two files and run `npm run config:build`. `npm run check` fails when this page, or the `config` part of the chart's [values.schema.json](../../ops/helm/unfold/values.schema.json), drifts from them.*

Unfold reads a JSON configuration file named by `--config` or `UNFOLD_CONFIG`, and the environment variables below. At startup it checks the file against [config.v1.schema.json](../contracts/config.v1.schema.json) and refuses to start with one error that lists every problem with its JSON Pointer, for example:

```text
config/live.local.json: 2 problems:
  /kubernetes/cpu: must match ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(m|[KMGT]i?)?$ (CPU limit of a workspace pod, such as 2.)
  /auths: unknown key (did you mean auth?)
```

An unknown or misspelt key is an error, not ignored. After the schema, Unfold applies the rules that span several settings, such as live mode needing `ploeg` and `execution`, and stops at the first that fails. Add `"$schema": "https://forgejo.webgrip.dev/webgrip/unfold/raw/branch/development/apps/unfold/docs/contracts/config.v1.schema.json"` to a configuration file to have an editor check it while you type.

A key ending in `Env` names an environment variable that holds a secret, so no secret sits in the file. Those variables are the deployment's choice and are not listed under [Environment variables](#environment-variables).

## In the Helm chart

The chart renders `config:` from its values into the file, and its [values.schema.json](../../ops/helm/unfold/values.schema.json) holds the same keys, types and limits, so `helm lint` and `helm template` stop on a misspelt key or a wrong value; a missing required key is reported by Unfold at startup. It writes `mode`, `dataDir`, `publicDir`, `runtime`, `kubernetes` and `auth.localLogin` itself and refuses them under `config:`. It also sets `baseUrl` when the chart value `baseUrl` is set, and `delivery` and `decider` from their own chart values when those are enabled.

## Environment variables

| Name | Type | Default | Overrides | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `UNFOLD_CONFIG` | path |  |  | Configuration file to read; --config wins over it. Without either, Unfold starts from defaults. |
| `UNFOLD_MODE` | live \| demo | `live` | `mode` | Mode; --demo wins over it. |
| `UNFOLD_DATA_DIR` | path | `.unfold` | `dataDir` | Directory for the database, workspaces and candidates. |
| `UNFOLD_HOST` | string | `127.0.0.1` | `host` | Address the HTTP server binds. |
| `UNFOLD_PORT` | integer | `4080` | `port` | Port the HTTP server listens on. |
| `UNFOLD_BASE_URL` | URL |  | `baseUrl` | Public URL people reach Unfold at; https turns on secure cookies and HSTS. |
| `UNFOLD_ADMIN_NAME` | string | `admin` |  | Name of the administrator created at first start; auth.bootstrapName wins over it. |
| `UNFOLD_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | secret |  |  | Password of that administrator, at least 12 characters; creates the account only when it is absent and local sign-in is on. |
| `UNFOLD_LOCAL_LOGIN` | true \| false | `true` | `auth.localLogin` | Whether people may sign in with a local name and password. |
| `UNFOLD_STORE_KEY` | secret |  |  | 32-byte key sealing internal state, as base64, base64url or 64 hex characters. Unset, Unfold keeps a key file next to the database. |
| `UNFOLD_GITLAB_CLIENT_ID` | string |  | `links.gitlab.clientId` | OAuth application id for linking GitLab accounts. |
| `UNFOLD_CLICKUP_CLIENT_ID` | string |  | `links.clickup.clientId` | OAuth application id for linking ClickUp accounts. |
| `UNFOLD_FLAGS_FILE` | path |  | `flags.file` | flagd file that wins over the inline flag rules and is watched. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | integer | `400` | `audit.retentionDays` | Days audit records are kept, 1 to 3650. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OTLP_URL` | URL |  | `audit.otlpUrl` | OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint the audit is sent to. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OTLP_HEADERS` | key=value,… |  |  | Headers sent with the audit export, written as OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS writes them. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_ADDR` | URL |  | `audit.openbao.address` | OpenBao address whose Transit key signs the daily audit checkpoints. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_MOUNT` | string | `transit` | `audit.openbao.mount` | Transit secrets engine mount path. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_KEY` | string | `unfold-audit` | `audit.openbao.key` | Transit key name. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_ROLE` | string |  | `audit.openbao.role` | Kubernetes auth role Unfold signs in to OpenBao as; preferred over a token. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_AUTH_MOUNT` | string | `kubernetes` | `audit.openbao.authMount` | Kubernetes auth method mount path. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_TOKEN` | secret |  |  | OpenBao token instead of a role; environment only. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_URL` | URL |  | `audit.checkpoints.url` | S3-compatible bucket audit checkpoints are copied to. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_REGION` | string | `us-east-1` | `audit.checkpoints.region` | Region in the request signature; auto for Cloudflare R2. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_PREFIX` | string | `unfold-audit` | `audit.checkpoints.prefix` | Object key prefix. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_LOCK_DAYS` | integer |  | `audit.checkpoints.lockDays` | Days S3 Object Lock retains each checkpoint, 1 to 36500. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | secret |  |  | Access key id of the checkpoint bucket; environment only. |
| `UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | secret |  |  | Secret access key of the checkpoint bucket; environment only. |
| `UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EVENTS` | on \| off | `on` |  | Whether product events from the browser are recorded. |
| `UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EXPORT` | off \| faro \| otlp | `off` |  | Sink product events are exported to. |
| `UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EXPORT_URL` | URL |  |  | Collector URL of the export; required for faro and otlp. |
| `UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EXPORT_LEVEL` | aggregate \| events | `aggregate` |  | aggregate sends each finished day's rollup; events sends each event with its pseudonymous actor hash. |
| `UNFOLD_SENTRY_DSN` | secret |  |  | Sentry-protocol DSN (Sentry, GlitchTip, Bugsink) errors are reported to. |
| `UNFOLD_ERROR_OTLP_URL` | URL |  |  | OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint errors are reported to. |
| `UNFOLD_ERROR_ENVIRONMENT` | string | `the mode` |  | Environment name error reports carry, such as staging. |
| `UNFOLD_PLOEG_MCP_URL` | URL |  |  | Exact resource URL of the remote ploeg-mcp that editors are told about; set together with UNFOLD_PLOEG_MCP_CLIENT_ID. |
| `UNFOLD_PLOEG_MCP_CLIENT_ID` | string |  |  | Public OAuth client registered for that server. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_RESOURCE` | URL |  |  | Exact public URL unfold-mcp is served at over HTTP, such as https://unfold.example/mcp; unset turns the HTTP transport off and refuses every other UNFOLD_MCP_ variable. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_ISSUER` | URL |  |  | Issuer of the access tokens unfold-mcp accepts; required with UNFOLD_MCP_RESOURCE. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_JWKS_URL` | URL |  |  | Signing keys of that issuer; discovered from the issuer when unset. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_TOKEN_AUDIENCE` | resource \| client-id | `resource` |  | Which aud a token must carry: the resource URL, or also one of UNFOLD_MCP_CLIENT_IDS. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_CLIENT_IDS` | comma-separated list |  |  | Client ids or Client ID Metadata Document URLs accepted; empty accepts every client of the issuer. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_SCOPE` | string | `unfold:mcp` |  | Scope a token must carry. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_REQUEST_SCOPES` | space-separated list | `UNFOLD_MCP_SCOPE` |  | Scopes clients are told to request; UNFOLD_MCP_SCOPE is always among them. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME` | duration | `10m` |  | Longest accepted token lifetime, such as 10m, at most 24h. |
| `UNFOLD_MCP_SUBJECT_NAMESPACE` | string |  |  | Namespace whose subjects match single sign-on's when the MCP issuer is on another origin. |
| `LITELLM_BASE_URL` | URL |  | `litellm.baseUrl` | Gateway inference URL including /v1. |
| `LITELLM_ADMIN_URL` | URL |  | `litellm.adminUrl` | Gateway root the Status page checks. |
| `LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` | secret |  |  | Not used under Ploeg, which holds the gateway management credential; leave it unset. Demo mode refuses to start with it. |
| `OPENCODE_URL` | URL |  | `runtime.endpoint` | External OpenCode server; selects the external backend, which live mode refuses. |
| `OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME` | string |  | `runtime.username` | User name for the external OpenCode server. |
| `OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD` | secret |  | `runtime.password` | Password for the external OpenCode server. |
| `KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST` | string | `kubernetes.default.svc` |  | In-cluster API host the Kubernetes backend and verifier use when kubernetes.apiUrl is unset; Kubernetes sets it. |
| `KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT` | integer | `443` |  | In-cluster API port the delivery verifier uses; Kubernetes sets it. |
| `KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT_HTTPS` | integer | `443` |  | In-cluster API port the Kubernetes backend uses; Kubernetes sets it. |
| `PATH` | path list |  |  | Passed to git and local agent processes Unfold starts. |
| `TMPDIR` | path | `/tmp` |  | Temporary directory passed to the demo runtime's processes. |

Variables Unfold sets in an agent workspace for the programs it runs there. Unfold writes them into the workspace environment and never reads them from its own. They are `BASE_BRANCH`, `CANDIDATE_BASE`, `CANDIDATE_EXPORT_DIR`, `CANDIDATE_REPOSITORY`, `CANDIDATE_SESSION`, `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`, `GIT_PASSWORD`, `GIT_USERNAME`, `HOME`, `LITELLM_API_KEY`, `REPOSITORY_URL`, `WORK_BRANCH`, `XDG_CACHE_HOME`, `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `XDG_DATA_HOME`.

## Configuration file

The JSON file Unfold reads from --config or UNFOLD_CONFIG. Keys are written as dotted paths: `[]` is any entry of a list and `<name>` any key of a map.

### Top-level settings

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | one of `live`, `demo` | `live` | live runs agent work under Ploeg; demo is the credential-free demonstration. UNFOLD_MODE and --demo override it. |
| `host` | string | `127.0.0.1` | Address the HTTP server binds. UNFOLD_HOST overrides it. |
| `port` | integer, 0–65535 | `4080` | Port the HTTP server listens on. UNFOLD_PORT overrides it. |
| `dataDir` | string | `.unfold` | Directory for the database, workspaces and candidates, created with mode 0700. UNFOLD_DATA_DIR overrides it. |
| `publicDir` | string | `public` | Directory of the browser application, relative to the working directory; the default is the application's own public folder. |
| `baseUrl` | string |  | Public URL people reach Unfold at; an https URL turns on secure cookies and HSTS. UNFOLD_BASE_URL overrides it. |
| `maxConcurrentSessions` | integer, 1–16 | `2` | How many sessions run at the same time. |
| `maxBudgetUsd` | number, 0.01–10000 | `25` | Largest budget in US dollars one session may request. |
| `trustedProxies` | list of string (at most 100 entries) |  | Addresses and CIDR ranges of the reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For names the client. Absent trusts none. |

### `repositories`

The repositories sessions may work on. Demo mode replaces them with the bundled example. Default: `[]`.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `repositories[].id` | string |  | Unique lowercase slug that names the repository. |
| `repositories[].name` | string |  | Name people see. |
| `repositories[].description` | string |  | One line people see under the name. |
| `repositories[].url` | string |  | Clone URL; in live mode an HTTP(S) URL without credentials. |
| `repositories[].baseBranch` | string |  | Branch work starts from and pull requests target. |
| `repositories[].verify` | list of string |  | Verification command as argv, run in the workspace, such as ["npm", "test"]. |
| `repositories[].trackerUrl` | string |  | Link to the repository's issue tracker. |
| `repositories[].executionOwner` | one of `interactive`, `ploeg` |  | Who runs work on this repository: people from the workbench (interactive) or Ploeg. |
| `repositories[].access` | object |  | Basic credentials the workspace clones with. Prefer kubernetes.gitSecretName, which keeps the password out of this file. |
| `repositories[].access.username` | string |  | Git user name. |
| `repositories[].access.password` | string |  | Git password or token. |
| `repositories[].mcp` | object |  | Read-only gateway MCP tools for sessions on this repository: session keys are minted into this LiteLLM team with exactly these access groups. |
| `repositories[].mcp.litellmTeamId` | string |  | LiteLLM team the session key is minted into. |
| `repositories[].mcp.accessGroups` | list of string (1–16 entries) |  | MCP access groups the key may use. |
| `repositories[].tenant` | string |  | Tenant that owns the repository (system ADR-0017); the default Tenant when absent. |
| `repositories[].client` | string |  | Client inside the Tenant that owns the repository. |

### `teams`

The Teams sessions run with, each a list of Roles run in order. Absent means the delivery and investigation Teams; demo mode uses delivery only.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `teams[].id` | string |  | Unique lowercase slug that names the Team. |
| `teams[].name` | string |  | Name people see. |
| `teams[].description` | string |  | One line people see under the name. |
| `teams[].roles` | list of object (1–8 entries) |  | Roles run in order. |
| `teams[].roles[].id` | string |  | Role id, unique in the Team. |
| `teams[].roles[].name` | string |  | Name people see. |
| `teams[].roles[].mode` | one of `read`, `write` |  | write may change the repository; read may not. |
| `teams[].roles[].instruction` | string |  | What the Role is told to do. |
| `teams[].roles[].model` | string |  | Model id from models; the session's or the first when absent. |
| `teams[].roles[].maxToolCalls` | integer, 1–2000 |  | Tool calls this Role may make in a Run; runtime.maxToolCalls when absent. |

### `crews`

Deprecated. Retired name of teams (system ADR-0036), still read. Set teams instead; both with different lists stops Unfold.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crews[].id` | string |  | Unique lowercase slug that names the Team. |
| `crews[].name` | string |  | Name people see. |
| `crews[].description` | string |  | One line people see under the name. |
| `crews[].roles` | list of object (1–8 entries) |  | Roles run in order. |
| `crews[].roles[].id` | string |  | Role id, unique in the Team. |
| `crews[].roles[].name` | string |  | Name people see. |
| `crews[].roles[].mode` | one of `read`, `write` |  | write may change the repository; read may not. |
| `crews[].roles[].instruction` | string |  | What the Role is told to do. |
| `crews[].roles[].model` | string |  | Model id from models; the session's or the first when absent. |
| `crews[].roles[].maxToolCalls` | integer, 1–2000 |  | Tool calls this Role may make in a Run; runtime.maxToolCalls when absent. |

### `models`

The models a session or Role may pick; the first is the default. Default: `[{"id":"coding","name":"Coding","providerId":"litellm","modelId":"coding"}]`.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `models[].id` | string |  | Id a Role's model or a session refers to. |
| `models[].name` | string |  | Name people see. |
| `models[].providerId` | string |  | Provider id in the agent's OpenCode configuration. |
| `models[].modelId` | string |  | Model alias the gateway serves. |

### `runtime`

How agent Runs execute and where their workspaces live.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `runtime.kind` | one of `demo`, `opencode`, `command` | `opencode` | Agent runtime: OpenCode, a command bridge, or the demo runtime (demo mode only). |
| `runtime.backend` | one of `local`, `external`, `docker`, `kubernetes` | `local` | Default workspace backend; with backends, the first listed unless this names another. external is refused in live mode. |
| `runtime.backends` | list of one of `docker`, `kubernetes`, `local` (at least 1 entries) |  | Workspace backends a session may choose from. |
| `runtime.binary` | string | `opencode` | OpenCode executable the local backend starts. |
| `runtime.endpoint` | string |  | External OpenCode server URL (backend external, demo only). OPENCODE_URL overrides it. |
| `runtime.username` | string |  | User name for the external OpenCode server. OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME overrides it. |
| `runtime.password` | string |  | Password for the external OpenCode server; prefer OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD, which overrides it. |
| `runtime.command` | list of string (at least 1 entries) |  | Command bridge argv for runtime kind command. |
| `runtime.timeoutMs` | integer, at least 1 | `1200000` | Longest one Run may take, in milliseconds. |
| `runtime.agentEnvironment` | list of string (at most 64 entries) | `[]` | Names of environment variables copied from the server into local and Docker workspaces; names carrying workbench, gateway, cluster or vault authority are refused. |
| `runtime.maxToolCalls` | integer, 1–2000 | `80` | Tool calls one Role may make in a Run, unless the Role sets its own. |
| `runtime.reconnectGraceMs` | integer, 1000–900000 | `300000` | How long a restarted workbench waits for a workspace worker to reconnect, in milliseconds. |
| `runtime.briefCheck` | boolean | `true` | Whether a configured model checks that a hand-written objective is actionable before the session starts. |

### `docker`

The Docker workspace backend. Read when runtime.backends lists docker.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `docker.image` | string |  | Agent image, such as unfold-agent:1.18.30. Required for the docker backend. |
| `docker.socketPath` | string |  | Docker Engine socket; the engine's default when absent. |
| `docker.network` | string |  | Docker network the container joins. |
| `docker.user` | string |  | Numeric uid or uid:gid the container runs as. |
| `docker.cpus` | number, 0.25–64 | `2` | CPUs per workspace container. |
| `docker.memoryMb` | integer, 256–262144 | `4096` | Memory per workspace container, in MiB. |
| `docker.pidsLimit` | integer, 32–65536 | `512` | Process limit per workspace container. |
| `docker.gatewayUrl` | string |  | Gateway URL as the container reaches it, when it differs from litellm.baseUrl. |
| `docker.transport` | one of `publish`, `pull` | `publish` | publish exposes the agent server on a host port; pull has the worker connect back to relayUrl. |
| `docker.relayUrl` | string |  | Workbench URL the container's worker connects back to (transport pull). |
| `docker.provisionTimeoutMs` | integer, 5000–3600000 | `180000` | How long a container may take to become ready, in milliseconds. |

### `kubernetes`

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `kubernetes.image` | string |  | Agent image of workspace pods. |

| `kubernetes.imagePullSecrets` | list of string |  | Secrets workspace pods pull the image with. |
| `kubernetes.storageClass` | string |  | StorageClass of workspace volumes; the cluster default when absent. |
| `kubernetes.storageSize` | string |  | Size of each workspace volume, such as 10Gi. |
| `kubernetes.cpu` | string |  | CPU limit of a workspace pod, such as 2. |
| `kubernetes.memory` | string |  | Memory limit of a workspace pod, such as 4Gi. |
| `kubernetes.cpuRequest` | string |  | CPU request of a workspace pod; the limit when absent. |
| `kubernetes.memoryRequest` | string |  | Memory request of a workspace pod; the limit when absent. |
| `kubernetes.apiUrl` | string |  | Kubernetes API URL; the in-cluster service when absent. |
| `kubernetes.tokenFile` | string | `/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token` | Service account token file. |
| `kubernetes.caFile` | string | `/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt` | Cluster CA certificate file. |
| `kubernetes.ingressFrom` | list of object |  | NetworkPolicy ingress peers allowed to reach workspace pods; the workbench pods when absent. |
| `kubernetes.egress` | list of object | `[]` | NetworkPolicy egress rules of workspace pods, such as the gateway and the forge. |
| `kubernetes.gitSecretName` | string |  | Secret with username and password keys the workspace clones with. |
| `kubernetes.gitRewrites` | list of object (at most 16 entries) |  | Git URL prefixes fetched from another address, such as a forge's in-cluster Service in place of its public URL. |
| `kubernetes.gitRewrites[].url` | string |  | Where git goes, ending in /. |

| `kubernetes.agentSecrets` | list of string |  | Secrets whose keys become environment variables of workspace pods. |
| `kubernetes.provisionTimeoutMs` | integer, at least 1 | `180000` | How long a workspace may take to become ready, in milliseconds. |

| `taskSources[].baseUrl` | string |  | Tracker API root, such as https://forge.example/api/v1; HTTPS except on loopback. |
| `taskSources[].project` | string |  | Repository, project or list on the tracker, in the provider's own form. |
| `taskSources[].repositoryId` | string |  | Registered repository the source's tasks change. |
| `taskSources[].tokenEnv` | string |  | Environment variable holding the tracker API token. |
| `taskSources[].executionOwner` | one of `interactive`, `ploeg` |  | Who runs the source's tasks: people from the workbench, or Ploeg. |
| `taskSources[].ploeg` | object |  | The Ploeg target tasks of this source are handed off to (Vikunja and ClickUp, executionOwner ploeg). |

| `taskSources[].ploeg.target.forge` | string |  | Forge name Ploeg knows. |
| `taskSources[].ploeg.target.owner` | string |  | Repository owner path. |
| `taskSources[].ploeg.target.repo` | string |  | Repository name. |
| `taskSources[].ploeg.target.baseBranch` | string |  | Base branch; the registered repository's baseBranch. |
| `taskSources[].tenant` | string |  | Tenant that owns the source; it must own the repository too. |

### `auth`

How people sign in.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth.localLogin` | boolean | `true` | Whether people may sign in with a local name and password; false needs oidc. UNFOLD_LOCAL_LOGIN overrides it. |

| `rateLimits.mutation` | object | `{"perMinute":300,"burst":120}` | Every change a person makes. |
| `rateLimits.mutation.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `rateLimits.mutation.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `rateLimits.ask` | object | `{"perMinute":20,"burst":10}` | Asks and card art generations, which spend model money. |
| `rateLimits.ask.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `rateLimits.ask.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `rateLimits.export` | object | `{"perMinute":20,"burst":10}` | Exports and downloads that read a lot at once. |
| `rateLimits.export.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `rateLimits.export.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `rateLimits.scim` | object | `{"perMinute":600,"burst":300}` | SCIM provisioning and Shared Signals, per address. |
| `rateLimits.scim.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `rateLimits.scim.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `rateLimits.mcp` | object | `{"perMinute":300,"burst":120}` | unfold-mcp over HTTP, per address. |
| `rateLimits.mcp.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `rateLimits.mcp.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `rateLimits.webhook` | object | `{"perMinute":120,"burst":60}` | Public notification channel routes, per address. |
| `rateLimits.webhook.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `rateLimits.webhook.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `rateLimits.signIn` | object | `{"perMinute":30,"burst":60}` | Sign-in routes, per address. |
| `rateLimits.signIn.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `rateLimits.signIn.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |

### `intake`

The public Request intake.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `intake.rateLimit` | object |  | Token buckets of the intake. |
| `intake.rateLimit.client` | object | `{"perMinute":60,"burst":30}` | Rate per sending address. |
| `intake.rateLimit.client.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `intake.rateLimit.client.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `intake.rateLimit.source` | object | `{"perMinute":300,"burst":60}` | Rate per source. |
| `intake.rateLimit.source.perMinute` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Tokens refilled per minute. |
| `intake.rateLimit.source.burst` | integer, 1–100000 |  | Requests allowed at once. |
| `intake.rateLimit.failureCost` | integer, 1–1000 | `5` | Tokens a refused delivery costs. |

### `billing`

One line per accepted Work Item into the Agency's billing tool (system ADR-0006); also behind the billing.export flag. Refused in demo mode.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `billing.exporter` | one of `simplicate`, `file` |  | Billing adapter; only its own block below is read. |
| `billing.currency` | string | `EUR` | ISO 4217 currency of the lines. |
| `billing.syncMinutes` | integer, 1–1440 | `15` | How often Unfold sends new lines, in minutes. |
| `billing.simplicate` | object |  | The Simplicate adapter. |
| `billing.simplicate.domain` | string |  | Simplicate subdomain, such as agency for agency.simplicate.nl; required unless apiUrl is set. |
| `billing.simplicate.apiUrl` | string |  | Explicit API root in place of the subdomain; https except on loopback. |
| `billing.simplicate.tokenEnv` | string |  | Environment variable holding the API key and secret as key:secret. |
| `billing.file` | object |  | The file adapter: CSV and UBL files any tool imports. |
| `billing.file.directory` | string | `billing-export` | Folder the files are written to, relative to dataDir. |

### `identity`

SCIM provisioning and the Shared Signals receiver; both need auth.oidc.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `identity.scim` | object |  | The SCIM service provider. |
| `identity.scim.tokenEnv` | string |  | UNFOLD_ environment variable holding the bearer token the identity provider sends, at least 32 characters. |
| `identity.scim.linkBy` | one of `externalId`, `userName`, `email` | `externalId` | SCIM User attribute that names the person who signs in. |
| `identity.sharedSignals` | object |  | The Shared Signals push receiver. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.audience` | string |  | Audience a Security Event Token must name; baseUrl when absent. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.maxAgeHours` | integer, 1–168 | `24` | Oldest Security Event Token accepted, in hours. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.transmitters` | list of object (1–20 entries) |  | Transmitters whose Security Event Tokens Unfold accepts. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.transmitters[].name` | string |  | Unique transmitter name. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.transmitters[].issuer` | string |  | Issuer its tokens name. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.transmitters[].jwksUri` | string |  | Its signing keys; https except on loopback. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.transmitters[].audience` | string |  | Audience its tokens name, when not the receiver's. |
| `identity.sharedSignals.transmitters[].authorizationEnv` | string |  | UNFOLD_ environment variable holding the Authorization value it pushes with. |
